version: V191 feedback-directed replay policy search and parametric sleep
authority: Latest direct user: put DreamRSI and Sleep into the learner loop; preserve four groups; one small pilot.

mechanism.initial_source: Each genuine V190 base checkpoint; old condition memory retained for provenance but never read by action selection.
mechanism.dream_inspiration: Learn a 3-parameter rehearsal-allocation policy. Actual temporary learner branches on observed history produce probe-loss feedback. Reuse all recorded branch outcomes to propose the next policy, retain the selected policy, then deploy its parameter update in actual new tasks. Not an original coding-agent Dream-RSI reproduction or an invented counterfactual world simulator.
sampling_features: current own supervised or TD error
mechanism.sleep: Fast teacher selected using training-history probe feedback; student starts from pre-sleep parameters and learns real labels plus 0.5 masked teacher distillation on actually observed actions. Teacher predictions are soft targets, not fabricated observations. No MoE or architecture growth.
mechanism.ordinary_learning: Original 1 update per 128 actual steps remains active for all groups.
mechanism.probe: 64 real recorded windows, disjoint by absolute-record block from sleep fitting windows. Used as meta-training feedback, not evaluation. Q probe targets fixed at round entry; factual labels fixed actual outcomes. No final evaluation feedback.
mechanism.F0: No external scalar reward packets, no Q head or Q updates; factual prediction error controls rehearsal and factual teacher outputs are distilled. Existing public goal readout unchanged.
mechanism.RL: Only its original reward/Q objective supplies replay/sleep feedback, no factual auxiliary head or movement rule. Both variants remain RL algorithms.
mechanism.retention: Old real replay included; fixed seen-map versus heldout-map evaluation reported, not a full continual-task forgetting benchmark.

evaluation.initial_bank: One actual bank per seed/arm, exact parameter/action equality shared by both variants. No old evaluation bank rerun.
evaluation.frozen: No network, replay, curator, persistent memory or reward updates in evaluation.

interpretation: Same additional interaction and total gradient-update count; candidate/probe forward compute and wall-time measured, not claimed equal.
A combined-method pilot, not separate causal proof of Dream and Sleep.
Four existing development seeds, not independent new-from-scratch training.
Positive, zero, negative accepted; no outcome-based input changes or automatic retry.
Original completed and failed sources remain unchanged; old 64-seed job and automation remain off.
